reason: Hypothesis B directly addresses the oxidation limitation of equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr with a physically sound aluminide coating mechanism that forms a protective alumina scale, is specific and testable with clear conditions and falsification, and extends prior oxidation-protection work on related alloys to this exact composition, whereas Hypothesis A relies on a reactive-element effect cited from unrelated Ni-based alloys (Inconel, Ni3Al) without evidence for refractory high-entropy alloys and risks altering bulk properties.
